primitives.name: External Expression Suppression
primitives.verbatim_quote: It is by such restraint that we are in the habit of suppressing pity, anger, fear, pride—on many trifling occasions.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'E_{ext}': 'dimensionless external expression intensity', 'E_{int}': 'dimensionless internal emotional intensity'}
primitives.assumptions: Suppression of E_{ext} leads to decay of E_{int}; linear dependence between expression and neural excitation.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When E_{ext} > threshold, E_{int} persists despite suppression.

layer2.mapping: GSI latent variable model maps E_{ext} to E_{int} via suppression kernel; GSE state transition uses E_{ext} as control input.
layer2.telemetry: Change in emotional tone over time under controlled expression.

primitives.name: Embodied Behavioral Induction
primitives.verbatim_quote: By acting out the external manifestations, we gradually infect the nerves leading to them, and finally waken up the diffusive current by a sort of action ab extra.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'B_{act}': 'dimensionless behavioral activation level', 'E_{int}': 'dimensionless internal emotional intensity'}
primitives.assumptions: B_{act} initiates E_{int} through somatic feedback; non-linear coupling between behavior and emotion.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When B_{act} < threshold, E_{int} fails to activate.

layer2.mapping: GSE behavioral state space is isomorphic to emotional activation manifold; GSI uses B_{act} to induce E_{int} via causal graph.
layer2.telemetry: Emotional arousal rate following behavioral intervention.

primitives.name: Expression Delay Counter
primitives.verbatim_quote: Count ten before venting your anger, and its occasion seems ridiculous.
primitives.assumptions: T_{delay} inversely correlates with A_{anger}; delayed expression reduces emotional magnitude.

layer2.mapping: GSI temporal smoothing filter applies T_{delay} to A_{anger}; GSE uses T_{delay} to modulate emotional response timing.
layer2.telemetry: Reduction in anger intensity after T_{delay} exceeds 10 seconds.
